Definition
[Parabolic dilations] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0252 1. Equation 8.8\group dilations-of-singularities

Given a sequence $(x_i,t_i)$ with $t_i\nearrow T\in (0,\infty ]$, define the parabolic dilations \[ g_i(t)\doteq |\Rm (x_i,t_i)|\cdot g\! \left(t_i+\frac{t}{|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|}\right), \] which exist for \[ -t_i|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|\le t < (T-t_i)|\Rm (x_i,t_i)|. \]
